decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (204/1569, HC_PP_004, HC_PP_003, HC.PP.002 and covering letter dated 29/09/2014 received on 01/10/2014, 638.TS.01, 18820 OGL rev 1, Flood risk assessment, transport assessment, Habitat survey, phase 1 pre-risk assessment received 06/10/2014 and HC.PP.006 as amended and HC.PP.007 received on 31/10/2014, HP.PP.001 as amended received on 07/11/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby approved shall cease on or before 3 years from the first occupation of the site or prior to this date if the site is no longer required for the use hereby approved in conjunction with the B8 use of the neighbouring site (178 Great South West Road)

Condition : 4 - A Site Operation Strategy shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the occupation of the site. This strategy shall include details of general site management, health and safety, staff welfare arrangements and staff parking. The operation of the site shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - A workplace travel plan shall be submitted to an approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the occupation of the site. This travel plan shall encourage staff to commute by sustainable and non-car based modes of transport.  The approved Workplace Travel Plan shall be adhered to throughout the duration of the use.

Condition : 6 - Details of the proposed cycle parking shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation of the site. The cycle parking shall be implemented in line with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - No infiltration of surface water drainage into the ground is permitted other than with the express written consent of the Local Planning Authority, which may be given for those parts of the site where it has been demonstrated that there is no resultant unacceptable risk to controlled waters. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 8 - An emergency flood plan shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to first occupation of the site. The Emergency Flood Plan should be adhered to for the entire period the site is used for the use hereby approved.
Condition : 9 - No permanent buildings, temporary (including portacabins) buildings or plant will be erected on site without planning permission
description: Change of use of land at the Heathrow Causeway Centre to be used for lorry parking for a period of 3 years
